source_correspondence: Vasy correction, both pages: omitted normal-coordinate derivative, two related widths and unsquared mixed-error control. Main paper, PDF 42–44: the complete statement and proof of Lemma 7.1 and the start of Proposition 7.3, used for scope and attribution. This lesson proves its stated elementary estimates, not that complete boundary-calculus theorem.
restoration_changes: Restore the generalized-flow link to current U053.
Bind exact calculus, root, real-power and Hamilton proofs; explicitly identify the complete arbitrary-Hilbert Cauchy–Schwarz proof and the operator-norm definition.
Remove the obsolete free-only aside while retaining both valid freely accessible primary sources and accurate credit.
Add an exact two-panel coordinate illustration of the existing derivative and sharp mixed-error formulas.
Clarify that switching the normal root reverses the normal contribution, yielding 1+2sqrt(delta/epsilon), rather than negating the whole derivative.
